info.title: Research Reader API
info.description:
Local-first bilingual research-paper reader.

This document is generated from the wire contract (ADR 0006).  At M0 it describes the component schemas and the error taxonomy; the path objects are added in M1 by the FastAPI application, which derives them from the same models.  Its absence of paths is a statement about what is implemented, not an omission.

servers.description: Default loopback binding. The service does not listen on a public interface by default.

BlockTextPatch.description: Correct OCR text for a block (spec 5.3).

base_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency on the block's OCR revision
base_revision.title: Base Revision

BlockTextPatch.title: BlockTextPatch

SpanWire.description: A source region in the frozen coordinate contract (spec 8).

bbox.description: Display-normalised [x0, y0, x1, y1], origin top-left of the displayed page, each value in 0..1
bbox.title: Bbox

raw_bbox.description: Bounding box in the source coordinate space
raw_bbox.title: Raw Bbox

SpanWire.title: SpanWire

ProcessingMode.description: Where work happens, shown to the user before anything is sent out.
ProcessingMode.title: ProcessingMode

ErrorCode.description: Business error codes, deliberately separate from HTTP status.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

scope.description: What the error applies to: request, document, job, block, ...
scope.title: Scope

JobEventWire.description: One increment on the job event stream (spec 9.1: resumable).
JobEventWire.title: JobEventWire

page_number.description: 1-based page number shown in the UI
page_number.title: Page Number

rotation.description: Page /Rotate. Only quarter turns are representable; arbitrary skew is an AffineTransform, not a rotation (ADR 0008).
rotation.title: Rotation

ReadingState.description:
Where the reader was in a document.

The document is identified by the request path, not by a field here, so this
payload cannot disagree with the URL it was sent to.
ReadingState.title: ReadingState

TranslationRequest.description: Request translation for pages, blocks or the whole document.

force.description: Re-translate even when a current cached result exists
force.title: Force

budget_limit.description: Maximum estimated spend for this job, in provider units
budget_limit.title: Budget Limit

TranslationRequest.title: TranslationRequest

base_version.description: Optimistic concurrency: reject if the current version differs
base_version.title: Base Version

BusinessError.description: A business error, with a machine-readable code.

loopbackSession.name: X-Session-Token
loopbackSession.description: A token minted at start-up and required on every mutating request. It protects against a browser page on another origin reaching the loopback service. Provider API keys are never sent to the client.

implemented: the component schemas below, enforced by tests
the error taxonomy and its HTTP status mapping
